Supreme Court hears multiple pleas on elections and bail

The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear a range of cases, including pleas related to delays in local body elections in Rajasthan and Maharashtra. The court is also addressing bail applications for individuals in high-profile cases and a property dispute. These hearings involve various state governments, election commissions, and private parties, highlighting the judiciary's role in electoral processes and legal matters.
